title: daphne glabra
intro: Daphne glabra, commonly known as the fragrant Daphne or yellow daphne, is a species of flowering plant in the family Thymelaeaceae. It is a shrub that offers a range of health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Daphne glabra include its ability to modulate the nervous system, providing relief from anxiety and stress, while its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids and terpenoids, contribute to its medicinal properties. Regular consumption of Daphne glabra has been associated with improved cardiovascular health and immune function, although more research is needed to confirm its full range of health benefits.
